capabilities: Open notes in reader mode automatically
Switch to edit mode on click or double-click
Place the cursor at a chosen position when editing starts
Configure click trigger, cursor placement, and per-device behavior via settings
Switch the active note to reader mode via a command
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation requires building from source or manually copying release files.
problem: Obsidian opens notes in the mode they were last used, so you must manually toggle between reader and edit mode each time.
summary: Wiki-style editing plugin that opens notes in reader mode by default and switches to edit mode with cursor placement on click or double-click.
